scripts.eas-build-pre-install: node -e "const{execSync:e}=require('child_process');const log=s=>process.stdout.write(s+'\n');try{log('BEFORE: '+e('pnpm --version').toString().trim());log('PATH: '+e('which pnpm').toString().trim());e('npm install -g pnpm@10.26.1',{stdio:'inherit'});const n=e('npm prefix -g').toString().trim()+'/bin/pnpm';const o=e('which pnpm').toString().trim();log('NEW: '+e(n+' --version').toString().trim()+' at '+n);try{e('cp -f '+n+' '+o);log('COPY SUCCESS: '+e('pnpm --version').toString().trim())}catch(x){log('COPY FAILED: '+x.message);try{e('ln -sf '+n+' '+o);log('SYMLINK OK: '+e('pnpm --version').toString().trim())}catch(y){log('SYMLINK FAILED: '+y.message)}}}catch(err){log('HOOK ERR: '+err.message)}"
scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; if [ "${EAS_BUILD}" = "1" ] || [ "${CI}" = "true" ] || [ "${CI}" = "1" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
